pre_dispatch_render_gate.required_storage: regular non-link, stable device/inode/size/mtime, exact byte equality to independent render, and exactly one terminal LF
no_start_rejections: identity or byte mutation during preflight
pre_dispatch_render_gate.post_call_correction_policy: never validates; verifier admission requires the current device/inode/size/mtime and bytes to equal the bound pre-dispatch observation and a fresh independent render
